20261119-chemistry-g12.material: Falgalka 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), marka la sameeyo habka xawaaraha bilowga, [O₂] la joogteeyay oo [NO] laba jibaarmay xawaaruhu wuxuu noqday 4 jibaar, [NO] la joogteeyay oo [O₂] laba jibaarmay xawaaruhu wuxuu noqday 2 jibaar. Waa maxay sharciga xawaaraha iyo wadarta darajada falgalkan?
20261119-chemistry-g12.s.s1.prompt: Falgalka 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), marka la sameeyo habka xawaaraha bilowga, [O₂] la joogteeyay oo [NO] laba jibaarmay xawaaruhu wuxuu noqday 4 jibaar, [NO] la joogteeyay oo [O₂] laba jibaarmay xawaaruhu wuxuu noqday 2 jibaar. Waa maxay sharciga xawaaraha iyo wadarta darajada falgalkan?
20261119-chemistry-g12.s.s1.explain: Marka $[\text{NO}]$ uu noqdo $2$ jibaar xawaaruhu wuxuu noqdaa $4$ jibaar, sidaa darteed $m=2$, marka $[\text{O}_2]$ uu noqdo $2$ jibaar xawaaruhu wuxuu noqdaa $2$ jibaar, sidaa darteed $n=1$. Sharciga xawaaraha waa $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, wadarta darajada falgalka-na waa $2 + 1 = 3$ darajo.
20261119-chemistry-g12.s.s1.hint.1: 2^m = 4 → m = 2 (darajo 2 NO ahaan) 2^n = 2 → n = 1 (darajo 1 O₂ ahaan)
20261119-chemistry-g12.s.s1.o.o0: v = k [NO]² [O₂],  falgal wadar ahaan darajo 3

20261121-chemistry-g12-1.title: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + kuleyl (ΔH < 0)
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.goal: Codso mabaadi'da N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + kuleyl (ΔH < 0) si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.material: Falgalkan gaaska ah ee exothermic ah wuxuu gaadhay dheellitir dynamic ah weel xidhan: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + kuleyl (ΔH < 0). Waa maxay xaaladaha ugu fiican ee la xakameeyo si loo kordhiyo soo-saarka ammonia (NH₃) xaaladda dheellitirka?
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.prompt: Falgalkan gaaska ah ee exothermic ah wuxuu gaadhay dheellitir dynamic ah weel xidhan: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + kuleyl (ΔH < 0). Waa maxay xaaladaha ugu fiican ee la xakameeyo si loo kordhiyo soo-saarka ammonia (NH₃) xaaladda dheellitirka?
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.explain: Maadaama ay tahay falgal exothermic ah ($\Delta H < 0$), heerkulka waa in la hoos dhigaa si falgalka hore ee kuleylka sii daaya uu u xoogaysto. 20261121-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.hint.1: Maadaama ay tahay falgal exothermic ah, marka heerkulka hoos loo dhigo dheellitirku wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa falgalka hore ee kuleylka sii daaya. Walxaha falgala 4 mol → walxaha soo baxa 2 mol, sidaa darteed marka cadaadiska la kordhiyo dheellitirku wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa falgalka hore ee leh mole yar.

20261121-chemistry-g12-2.material: Heerkul 25℃, waa kuwee astaamaha saxda ah ee 'buffer solution' lagu sameeyay isku darka mugga isku mid ah ee 0.1 M acetic acid (CH₃COOH, joogtada ionization Ka = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵) iyo 0.1 M sodium acetate (CH₃COONa)?

20261121-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.explain: Maadaama buffer solution-ku ku jiro acid daciif ah ($\text{CH}_3\text{COOH}$) iyo conjugate base ($\text{CH}_3\text{COO}^-$) isla mar, marka acid xoog badan ($\text{H}^+$) laga soo daro dibadda conjugate base-ku wuu falgalaa, marka base xoog badan ($\text{OH}^-$) la daro acid daciifku wuu falgalaa, sidaasuu u yareeyaa isbeddelka $\text{pH}$.

20261122-chemistry-g12-2.material: Isleegga kiimikada ee kala jabka sodium azide adag (NaN₃) ee ka buufiya airbag-ka 0.03 ilbiriqsi gudahood marka shil gaari dhaco waa 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Waa maxay sababta kiimikada ugu fiican ee falgalkan ugu habboon yahay soo-saarka gaaska airbag-ka?
